title: Cherry Tomato Caprese with Garlicky Tomato-Juice Dressing
changes_from_base: Quartered cherry tomatoes and cubed mozzarella are tossed, not sliced and layered, and the dressing is made from their own reduced juice.
summary: A chopped caprese of quartered cherry tomatoes and cubed mozzarella, dressed with the tomatoes' own juice simmered down with garlic and cider vinegar.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fresh mozzarella or bocconcini (animal-rennet-free), cut into 1.5 cm cubes

steps.title: Salt the tomatoes
steps.text: Toss the tomatoes with the salt and sugar and leave 30 min.

steps.title: Collect the juice
steps.text: Spin the tomatoes briefly in the salad spinner, then strain the juice into the saucepan, pressing on the seeds.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Add the vinegar and garlic to the juice and simmer 4-5 min until only about 3 tbsp remains. Cool, then whisk in the oil and pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Return the tomatoes to the bowl with the mozzarella, basil and dressing and toss.

tips: Salting draws out the juice that becomes the dressing.
Pat the mozzarella dry so it does not water down the salad.
Mixed red and yellow tomatoes make it look even better.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
